about: AI-generated portraits of fictional people (no real person is depicted), made with OpenAI's image tool (HEADSHOT-GEN-LIBRARY). Each face is one fictional person with images at several ages; the game shows the last stage whose min_age is at or below the person's age (faces.py).
made_with: OpenAI image generation (Codex built-in image tool)

gen-player-m.use: Made-up draft prospects and the players they become
